propositions: The retired .reconciler-* gitattributes merge=ours strip arm in init.py is permanently unreachable because the reconciler already migrated to refs/reconciler/* and the store's committed .gitattributes no longer contains the deprecated line.
The _RETIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES constant and its associated strip logic (init.py:600-616) must be removed along with the migration test in test_gitattributes_merge.py:104-116.
The gitattributes ensure-unit's create arm must remain functional and continue to write the .bridge_state/* merge=ours carve-out for new .gitattributes files.
The test drift matrix must be retargeted from 'committed .gitattributes carries retired line' to 'no committed .gitattributes at all' to remain convergent with the surviving create arm.
A pre-1.0 breaking change entry must be added to release-notes.md documenting operator-approved removal from the deprecation survey.
